# Events

`cinnabar:extension/events@0.1.0`

Local presentation cues shared by loaded mods; they carry no authority.

**Grants:** None; cues carry no game authority.

## Types

<a id="type-cue"></a>

### `cue`

A presentation-only signal with bounded scalar values, shared on the following frame.

```wit
record cue {
    name: string,
    values: list<f32>,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` |  |
| `values` | `list<f32>` |  |

## Functions

<a id="emit"></a>

### `emit`

```wit
emit: func(name: string, values: list<f32>) -> result<_, string>;
```

Published to the host and every loaded mod after frame returns.

<a id="poll"></a>

### `poll`

```wit
poll: func() -> list<cue>;
```

Cues loaded mods committed last frame; the same bounded list for every call in a callback.

Types: [`cue`](events.md#type-cue).
